title: Use OptiSweep Robot Selection “Go-to function” to send an AGV (not in a task) to a target map cell
summary: Use the OptiSweep Robot Selection “Go-to function” to reposition an AGV that is not currently in a task (documented as the green/ready state) by selecting the AGV, selecting Go-to, clicking the destination cell on the map, and confirming. This avoids physically pushing the AGV.
when_to_use: Use when an AGV is in the documented green state (ready to execute something but not assigned a task) and you need to quickly reposition it to a different square/cell on the map without physically pushing it.
not_for: Do not use this procedure for AGVs that are already in a task (the source describes Go-to for an AGV not in a task).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the Robot Selection steps (select AGV, choose Go-to, select destination cell on the map, confirm) and verify the AGV navigates to the selected location.
safety_notes: The source describes that Go-to is helpful because it saves the operator from pushing the AGV from one point to the other.

system_preconditions: The target AGV must be in the documented green state meaning it is ready to execute something but does not have a task.

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Go-to function segment showing: AGV not in a task can be sent to any square; select AGV → Go to → select square/cell on map → Confirm; includes green/ready/no-task context and the click-on-map behavior.
Robot Selection overview showing robot selection behavior and robot status color meanings (including green = not in a task).

steps.title: Identify an AGV in the documented green state (ready but not in a task)
steps.purpose: Ensure the Go-to function is used for the correct AGV condition (not currently in a task).
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep Robot Selection area, locate an AGV shown in the documented green state (idle/not in a task).
steps.expected_result: You have identified an AGV that is in the green state indicating it is not in a task.
steps.healthy_condition: The selected AGV is shown as green (robot idle, not in a task).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV is not in the green state (e.g., it is in task/searching or shows fault/low battery), meaning it is not the documented “not in a task” condition for this procedure.

actions.label: Verify AGV is green (not in a task)
actions.exact_action: Identify an AGV that is in the documented “green state” meaning it is ready to execute something but does not have a task.

steps.title: Select the AGV in Robot Selection
steps.purpose: Set the correct AGV as the target for the Go-to command.
steps.instruction: In the Robot Selection area, click/select the AGV you identified in the green state.
steps.expected_result: The AGV becomes selected in the Robot Selection panel (selection box/selected state).
steps.healthy_condition: The selected AGV is visibly highlighted/boxed as the current selection.
steps.failure_condition: No AGV selection is registered (no highlighted/selected AGV), or the wrong AGV is selected.

steps.title: Select the Go-to function
steps.purpose: Open the Go-to workflow to move the selected AGV to a chosen map cell.
steps.instruction: With the AGV selected, choose the “Go to” / “Go-to function” option in the Robot Selection controls.
steps.expected_result: The UI enters the Go-to target selection prompt/workflow for the selected AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: A target selection step is available (prompting for which square/cell the AGV should go to).
steps.failure_condition: The Go-to workflow does not appear or does not prompt for a target square/cell.

steps.title: Choose the destination square/cell by clicking on the map
steps.purpose: Set the destination location for the Go-to command without typing a target code.
steps.instruction: When prompted for the target code/square, click directly on the map to select the destination cell/square (no need to type the target code).
steps.expected_result: A destination cell/square is selected on the map for the Go-to command.
steps.healthy_condition: The map click selects a cell/square and the UI proceeds with the chosen target for confirmation.
steps.failure_condition: The UI does not accept the selected target/cell (e.g., selection is not registered or cannot proceed to Confirm).

actions.label: Click destination cell on map
actions.exact_action: click on the map itself. You can click on a cell and confirm

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot get the UI to accept the selected target/cell.

steps.title: Confirm to send the AGV to the chosen location
steps.purpose: Transmit the Go-to command to the selected AGV with the chosen destination.
steps.instruction: Select “Confirm” to send the AGV to the selected map square/cell.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to command is issued and the AGV begins navigating to the selected location.
steps.healthy_condition: After confirmation, the AGV navigates to the chosen map square/cell (repositioning without physical pushing).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not navigate to the selected location, or remains in the documented green state (ready but no task) after repositioning.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot get the AGV to leave the problematic area or if the UI does not accept the selected target/cell.

If the AGV does not pick up a task after repositioning and remains in the documented green state (ready but no task), use the remove-and-add approach and/or send it to the hospital as described in the segment.

steps.title: Verify the AGV navigates to the selected location
steps.instruction: Observe the AGV on the map to verify it navigates to the selected square/cell (repositioning without physically pushing it).
steps.expected_result: The selected AGV moves to the chosen map square/cell using the Go-to function.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV’s position on the map updates to the selected destination cell/square.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not move to the selected destination or remains stuck in the problematic area.

actions.label: Verify map position update
actions.exact_action: Verify the AGV navigates to the selected location (repositioning without physically pushing it).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot get the AGV to leave the problematic area.

success_criteria: The AGV that was in the documented green state is repositioned to the selected map square/cell after selecting Go-to and Confirm.
The AGV navigates to the chosen location without physical pushing.
healthy_conditions: AGV is shown as green when it is ready but not in a task (used as the starting condition).
After Confirm, the AGV’s map position updates to the selected destination cell/square.
failure_conditions: The UI does not accept the selected target/cell.
After repositioning, the AGV does not pick up a task and remains in the documented green state (ready but no task).
The AGV cannot leave the problematic area.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if you cannot get the AGV to leave the problematic area or if the UI does not accept the selected target/cell.
If the AGV does not pick up a task after repositioning and remains in the documented green state, use the remove-and-add approach and/or send it to the hospital as described in the segment.
